newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: St Lukes may not show same growth as 95/6.
newsitem.headline: St Lukes may not show same growth as 95/6.

text.p: St Lukes Group Ltd chairman Bill Falconer told shareholders on Friday that final tax paid earnings may not show the same growth as in the past year.

"Operating earnings are anticipated to grow as WestCity revenues come on stream and the rent review and rent expiry programme at other centres continues during the year," he said at the annual meeting.

"However, with the increase in interest rates and the uncertainty as to the timing of the sale of the Downtown Centre, the final earnings after tax position may not demonstrate the same growth experienced in the year just past.
"However, the operating earnings growth will provide a platform for further increases in property valuations and underpin our earnings potential for subsequent years," he said.
